This plot is my intercropped plot — I mix crops together the way we have always done here in Iringa. Since it is not pure maize, I do not think buying fertilizer from the shop is worth it for this piece; the rains here are good and I will use manure from my animals instead. I will plant seed I kept from last season, and my family will do most of the work, though I will hire a few people for weeding when the rains come heavy.
